description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultConnectionLimitManager class, verifying its behavior in different connection limit scenarios.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManagerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of DefaultConnectionLimitManager.

methods.name: testLimitIsEqual
methods.description: Tests that the limit is considered exceeded when the current connections equal the maximum allowed.

methods.name: testLimitIsLower
methods.description: Tests that the limit is considered exceeded when the current connections exceed the maximum.

methods.name: testLimitIsHigher
methods.description: Tests that the limit is not exceeded when current connections are below the maximum.

methods.name: testAutoconfigIfNotConfigured
methods.description: Verifies default behavior of using the recommended limit when no explicit limit is configured.

methods.name: testAutoconfigIfConfigIsNull
methods.description: Verifies behavior when configuration is null, ensuring the default recommended limit is used.
